ko.title: 톱, 스프레이 페인트, 픽업트럭: 번호판 카메라 네트워크에 대한 거세지는 반발의 실내

segments.src: ## A Quiet Piece of Street Furniture Becomes a Flashpoint
segments.tr: ## 조용한 거리의 시설물이 뇌관이 되다

segments.src: For years, the solar-powered cameras mounted on poles at neighborhood entrances and highway shoulders drew little attention.
segments.tr: 수년 동안 동네 입구와 고속도로 갓길의 기둥에 설치된 태양광 구동 카메라는 거의 주목을 받지 못했습니다.

segments.src: Today, in communities across the country, those same devices have become the target of a sustained wave of public frustration — and, in a number of documented cases, outright vandalism.
segments.tr: 오늘날 전국 각지의 지역사회에서 이 동일한 장치들은 지속적인 대중의 불만, 그리고 일부 문서화된 사례에서는 노골적인 기물 파손의 표적이 되었습니다.

segments.src: The cameras in question are largely made by Flock Safety, a fast-growing company whose automated license-plate readers (ALPRs) have been adopted by thousands of police departments and homeowners' associations.
segments.tr: 문제의 카메라는 주로 수천 개의 경찰서와 주택 소유자 협회에서 도입한 급성장 중인 기업인 Flock Safety사에서 제작한 자동 번호판 판독기(ALPR)입니다.

segments.src: According to local news reports gathered from multiple states, some units have been found cut from their mounts, defaced with paint, or struck by vehicles.
segments.tr: 여러 주에서 수집된 지역 뉴스 보도에 따르면, 일부 장치는 마운트에서 잘려나가거나, 페인트로 훼손되거나, 차량에 부딪힌 것으로 확인되었습니다.

segments.src: Law enforcement officials in several jurisdictions have opened investigations into these incidents, treating them as property-damage or criminal-mischief cases.
segments.tr: 여러 관할 구역의 법 집행 기관은 이러한 사건들을 재산 피해 또는 형사적 장난 사건으로 취급하여 조사를 시작했습니다.

segments.src: This article does not endorse or provide guidance on damaging public or private property, which is illegal and can carry serious criminal penalties.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 공공 또는 사유 재산을 손상시키는 행위를 지지하거나 이에 대한 지침을 제공하지 않으며, 이는 불법이고 심각한 형사 처벌을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: What follows is a look at why a piece of everyday infrastructure has become so contested, and what it says about the broader debate over surveillance technology in American public life.
segments.tr: 이어지는 내용은 일상적인 인프라의 한 조각이 왜 그토록 논란의 대상이 되었는지, 그리고 그것이 미국 공공 생활 속 감시 기술을 둘러싼 광범위한 논쟁에 대해 무엇을 말해주는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: ## Why Residents Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## 주민들이 반발하는 이유

segments.src: Civil liberties organizations, including the Electronic Frontier Foundation and the American Civil Liberties Union, have spent several years warning that networks of ALPR cameras create a de facto tracking system.
segments.tr: 전자 프론티어 재단(Electronic Frontier Foundation)과 미국 시민자유연맹(American Civil Liberties Union)을 포함한 시민 자유 단체들은 ALPR 카메라 네트워크가 사실상의 추적 시스템을 만든다고 수년 동안 경고해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Individually, each camera simply logs a plate number, timestamp, and location.
segments.tr: 개별적으로 각 카메라는 단순히 번호판 번호, 타임스탬프, 위치를 기록합니다.

segments.src: Collectively, advocates argue, a dense network can reconstruct a detailed picture of where a private vehicle — and by extension, its driver — has been over days, weeks, or months, often without a warrant.
segments.tr: 옹호론자들은 종합적으로 볼 때 조밀한 네트워크가 영장 없이도 사유 차량, 그리고 확장하여 운전자가 며칠, 몇 주 또는 몇 달 동안 어디에 있었는지에 대한 상세한 그림을 재구성할 수 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: That concern has resonated well beyond activist circles.
segments.tr: 그러한 우려는 운동가들의 울타리를 넘어 큰 공감을 얻었습니다.

segments.src: Homeowners in some subdivisions have objected to being tracked every time they leave their own neighborhood.
segments.tr: 일부 세분화된 지역의 주택 소유자들은 자신들의 동네를 떠날 때마다 추적당하는 것에 반대해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Others have raised questions about who can access the data, how long it is retained, and whether it could be shared with agencies pursuing unrelated investigations, including in states with different laws on reproductive health or immigration enforcement.
segments.tr: 다른 이들은 누가 데이터에 액세스할 수 있는지, 얼마나 오래 보관되는지, 생식 건강이나 이민 집행에 대한 법률이 다른 주를 포함하여 관련 없는 조사를 수행하는 기관과 공유될 수 있는지에 대해 질문을 제기했습니다.

segments.src: Flock Safety has said its systems are built with audit trails and access controls, and that the technology has helped police departments solve crimes ranging from car theft to abductions.
segments.tr: Flock Safety는 자사의 시스템이 감사 추적 및 액세스 제어로 구축되었으며, 이 기술이 경찰서가 차량 도난에서 유괴에 이르는 범죄를 해결하는 데 도움이 되었다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to internal policies meant to restrict how footage can be queried and shared.
segments.tr: 이 회사는 또한 영상이 조회되고 공유되는 방식을 제한하기 위한 내부 정책을 지적했습니다.

segments.src: Still, the gap between how the technology is marketed — as a tool for solving specific crimes — and how it is actually used in practice has fueled skepticism.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 이 기술이 마케팅되는 방식(특정 범죄 해결 도구로서)과 실제 사용되는 방식 사이의 격차는 회의론을 부채질했습니다.

segments.src: Local reporting has documented cases where camera data was queried far more broadly than departments initially described, prompting renewed scrutiny from city councils and privacy-minded lawmakers.
segments.tr: 지역 보도에 따르면 카메라 데이터가 부서가 처음 설명한 것보다 훨씬 더 광범위하게 조회된 사례들이 기록되어 시의회와 프라이버시를 중시하는 의원들로부터 새로운 조사를 촉발했습니다.

segments.src: ## Cities Hit the Brakes
segments.tr: ## 제동을 건 도시들

segments.src: That scrutiny has translated into concrete policy reversals.
segments.tr: 그러한 조사는 구체적인 정책 철회로 이어졌습니다.

segments.src: Local governments in roughly 100 cities have reportedly voted to deactivate their camera networks, decline to renew existing contracts, or pause new deployments while officials review privacy safeguards, according to tallies compiled by advocacy groups and local news outlets.
segments.tr: 옹호 단체와 지역 언론사들이 집계한 통계에 따르면, 약 100개 도의 지방 정부가 카메라 네트워크 비활성화, 기존 계약 갱신 거부, 또는 관계자들이 프라이버시 보호 장치를 검토하는 동안 새로운 배포 중단에 투표한 것으로 보도되었습니다.

segments.src: City council meetings in several states have turned into extended public hearings, with residents on both sides — those who credit the cameras with deterring break-ins and recovering stolen vehicles, and those who see them as an unaccountable surveillance layer — testifying at length.
segments.tr: 여러 주의 시의회 회의는 연장된 공청회로 변모했으며, 양측의 주민들—카메라가 침입을 저지하고 도난당한 차량을 회수한 공로를 인정하는 사람들, 그리고 이를 책임감 없는 감시 계층으로 보는 사람들—이 장황하게 증언했습니다.

segments.src: Some departments that paused their programs have cited cost and transparency concerns as much as privacy ones, noting that subscription-based camera networks carry recurring fees that can be difficult to justify to budget-conscious councils without clear, publicly reported outcomes.
segments.tr: 프로그램을 중단한 일부 부서에서는 구독 기반 카메라 네트워크가 명확하고 공개적으로 보고되는 결과 없이 예산에 민감한 의회에 정당화하기 어려운 반복 수수료를 수반한다는 점을 지적하며 프라이버시 문제 못지않게 비용과 투명성 문제를 인용했습니다.

segments.src: ## A Market Opportunity for Rivals
segments.tr: ## 경쟁사들에게 찾아온 시장 기회

segments.src: The backlash has not gone unnoticed by Flock Safety's competitors.
segments.tr: 이러한 반발은 Flock Safety의 경쟁사들의 눈에 띄지 않은 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Axon, best known for police body cameras and Taser devices, has expanded its own automated license-plate reading offerings and has begun courting departments that are reconsidering their vendor relationships.
segments.tr: 경찰 바디캠과 테이저건으로 가장 잘 알려진 Axon은 자체 자동 번호판 판독 제품군을 확장했으며 공급업체 관계를 재고하는 부서들에 구애를 시작했습니다.

segments.src: Other, smaller players in the public-safety technology space are making similar pitches, often emphasizing more granular data-retention controls, local (rather than cloud-based) storage options, or stricter limits on cross-agency data sharing as a way to address the concerns driving the backlash.
segments.tr: 공공 안전 기술 분야의 다른 소규모 플레이어들도 유사한 제안을 하고 있으며, 종종 반발을 유발하는 우려를 해결하기 위한 방법으로 더 세분화된 데이터 보관 제어, 로컬(클라우드 기반이 아닌) 저장 옵션, 또는 교차 기관 데이터 공유에 대한 더 엄격한 제한을 강조하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Industry analysts note that the fight is unlikely to be resolved quickly.
segments.tr: 업계 분석가들은 이 싸움이 빨리 해결될 것 같지 않다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Automated license-plate readers sit at the intersection of two trends that show no sign of slowing: rising demand from police departments for cost-effective investigative tools, and rising public wariness of always-on data collection in daily life.
segments.tr: 자동 번호판 판독기는 둔화될 기미가 보이지 않는 두 가지 트렌드, 즉 비용 효율적인 수사 도구에 대한 경찰서의 수요 증가와 일상생활에서 상시 가동되는 데이터 수집에 대한 대중의 경계심 증가의 교차점에 놓여 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 다가올 것

segments.src: Several states are now considering legislation that would set statewide standards for ALPR data retention, require warrants for certain types of queries, or mandate public reporting on how camera networks are used.
segments.tr: 여러 주는 이제 ALPR 데이터 보관에 대한 주 차원의 표준을 설정하고, 특정 유형의 조회에 영장을 요구하거나, 카메라 네트워크 사용 방식에 대한 공개 보고를 의무화하는 입법을 검토하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Flock Safety has said it supports "reasonable" regulation and has worked with some state legislatures on model policies.
segments.tr: Flock Safety는 "합리적인" 규제를 지지하며 모델 정책에 대해 일부 주 의회와 협력했다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Privacy advocates counter that self-regulation by vendors is insufficient and are pushing for binding state or federal rules.
segments.tr: 프라이버시 옹호론자들은 공급업체에 의한 자체 규제가 불충분하다고 반박하며 구속력 있는 주 또는 연방 규칙을 촉구하고 있습니다.

segments.src: For now, the debate playing out in city council chambers — and, less constructively, on roadside utility poles — reflects a broader American reckoning with how much automated tracking the public is willing to accept in exchange for the promise of safer streets.
segments.tr: 현재 시의회 회의실에서—그리고 덜 건설적으로는 도로변 유틸리티 폴에서—벌어지고 있는 논쟁은 더 안전한 거리라는 약속을 대가로 대중이 수용할 의향이 있는 자동화된 추적의 양에 대한 광범위한 미국의 숙고를 반영합니다.

segments.src: Whether that balance tips toward wider adoption, stricter regulation, or a patchwork of local bans is likely to be decided community by community over the next several years.
segments.tr: 그 균형이 더 넓은 채택, 더 엄격한 규제, 또는 지역 금지의 패치워크로 기울지는 향후 몇 년 동안 지역사회별로 결정될 것입니다.

zh.title: 锯子、喷漆和皮卡车：深入了解针对车牌摄像头网络的日益增长的抵制浪潮

segments.src: ## A Quiet Piece of Street Furniture Becomes a Flashpoint
segments.tr: ## 一种安静的街道设施成为冲突焦点

segments.src: For years, the solar-powered cameras mounted on poles at neighborhood entrances and highway shoulders drew little attention.
segments.tr: 多年来，安装在社区入口和高速公路路肩电线杆上的太阳能摄像头几乎没有引起人们的注意。

segments.src: Today, in communities across the country, those same devices have become the target of a sustained wave of public frustration — and, in a number of documented cases, outright vandalism.
segments.tr: 如今，在全国各地的社区中，这些设备已成为公众持续不满的目标——在一些有记录的案例中，甚至遭到了彻底的破坏。

segments.src: The cameras in question are largely made by Flock Safety, a fast-growing company whose automated license-plate readers (ALPRs) have been adopted by thousands of police departments and homeowners' associations.
segments.tr: 这些摄像头主要由 Flock Safety 制造，这是一家快速发展的公司，其自动车牌识别系统 (ALPR) 已被数千个警察部门和业主协会采用。

segments.src: According to local news reports gathered from multiple states, some units have been found cut from their mounts, defaced with paint, or struck by vehicles.
segments.tr: 根据从多个州收集的地方新闻报道，一些设备被发现从安装架上被切断、被油漆涂抹或被车辆撞击。

segments.src: Law enforcement officials in several jurisdictions have opened investigations into these incidents, treating them as property-damage or criminal-mischief cases.
segments.tr: 多个司法管辖区的执法官员已对这些事件展开调查，将其视为财产损失或刑事破坏案件。

segments.src: This article does not endorse or provide guidance on damaging public or private property, which is illegal and can carry serious criminal penalties.
segments.tr: 本文不认可也不提供关于破坏公共或私人财产的指导，这种行为是非法的，并可能导致严重的刑事处罚。

segments.src: What follows is a look at why a piece of everyday infrastructure has become so contested, and what it says about the broader debate over surveillance technology in American public life.
segments.tr: 以下内容将探讨为何这种日常基础设施变得如此具有争议，以及它反映了美国公共生活中关于监控技术的更广泛辩论。

segments.src: ## Why Residents Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## 为什么居民们在进行抵制

segments.src: Civil liberties organizations, including the Electronic Frontier Foundation and the American Civil Liberties Union, have spent several years warning that networks of ALPR cameras create a de facto tracking system.
segments.tr: 包括电子前沿基金会 (Electronic Frontier Foundation) 和美国公民自由联盟 (American Civil Liberties Union) 在内的公民自由组织多年来一直警告称，ALPR 摄像头网络实际上构成了一个追踪系统。

segments.src: Individually, each camera simply logs a plate number, timestamp, and location.
segments.tr: 单独来看，每个摄像头只是记录车牌号码、时间戳和位置。

segments.src: Collectively, advocates argue, a dense network can reconstruct a detailed picture of where a private vehicle — and by extension, its driver — has been over days, weeks, or months, often without a warrant.
segments.tr: 倡导者认为，从整体上看，一个密集的网络可以在无需搜查令的情况下，重构出一辆私家车——进而推及其驾驶员——在数天、数周或数月内的详细行踪。

segments.src: That concern has resonated well beyond activist circles.
segments.tr: 这种担忧在活动家圈子之外也引起了广泛共鸣。

segments.src: Homeowners in some subdivisions have objected to being tracked every time they leave their own neighborhood.
segments.tr: 一些小区里的业主反对每次离开自家社区时都被追踪。

segments.src: Others have raised questions about who can access the data, how long it is retained, and whether it could be shared with agencies pursuing unrelated investigations, including in states with different laws on reproductive health or immigration enforcement.
segments.tr: 其他人则提出了关于谁可以访问这些数据、数据保留多久，以及是否可以与正在进行无关调查的机构共享数据的问题，包括在那些对生殖健康或移民执法有不同法律规定的州。

segments.src: Flock Safety has said its systems are built with audit trails and access controls, and that the technology has helped police departments solve crimes ranging from car theft to abductions.
segments.tr: Flock Safety 表示，其系统内置了审计追踪和访问控制功能，该技术已帮助警察部门破获了从汽车盗窃到绑架等各类犯罪。

segments.src: The company has also pointed to internal policies meant to restrict how footage can be queried and shared.
segments.tr: 该公司还指出了旨在限制如何查询和共享监控录像的内部政策。

segments.src: Still, the gap between how the technology is marketed — as a tool for solving specific crimes — and how it is actually used in practice has fueled skepticism.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，该技术的营销方式（作为解决特定犯罪的工具）与其实际使用方式之间的差距加剧了人们的怀疑。

segments.src: Local reporting has documented cases where camera data was queried far more broadly than departments initially described, prompting renewed scrutiny from city councils and privacy-minded lawmakers.
segments.tr: 地方报道记录了一些案例，其中摄像头数据的查询范围远比部门最初描述的要广泛，这促使市议会和关注隐私的立法者重新进行审查。

segments.src: ## Cities Hit the Brakes
segments.tr: ## 城市踩下刹车

segments.src: That scrutiny has translated into concrete policy reversals.
segments.tr: 这种审查已经转化为具体的政策逆转。

segments.src: Local governments in roughly 100 cities have reportedly voted to deactivate their camera networks, decline to renew existing contracts, or pause new deployments while officials review privacy safeguards, according to tallies compiled by advocacy groups and local news outlets.
segments.tr: 据倡导团体和当地新闻媒体汇编的数据显示，大约 100 个城市的地方政府已投票决定停用其摄像头网络、拒绝续签现有合同，或在官员审查隐私保护措施期间暂停新的部署。

segments.src: City council meetings in several states have turned into extended public hearings, with residents on both sides — those who credit the cameras with deterring break-ins and recovering stolen vehicles, and those who see them as an unaccountable surveillance layer — testifying at length.
segments.tr: 多个州的市议会会议已演变成延长的公开听证会，双方居民——那些认为摄像头能威慑入室盗窃和找回被盗车辆的人，以及那些将其视为一种无法问责的监控层的人——都在会上进行了详细作证。

segments.src: Some departments that paused their programs have cited cost and transparency concerns as much as privacy ones, noting that subscription-based camera networks carry recurring fees that can be difficult to justify to budget-conscious councils without clear, publicly reported outcomes.
segments.tr: 一些暂停该计划的部门提到的成本和透明度问题与隐私问题同样重要，他们指出，基于订阅的摄像头网络会产生经常性费用，如果没有明确、公开的成果报告，很难向注重预算的议会证明其合理性。

segments.src: ## A Market Opportunity for Rivals
segments.tr: ## 竞争对手的市场机会

segments.src: The backlash has not gone unnoticed by Flock Safety's competitors.
segments.tr: 这种抵制并没有被 Flock Safety 的竞争对手忽视。

segments.src: Axon, best known for police body cameras and Taser devices, has expanded its own automated license-plate reading offerings and has begun courting departments that are reconsidering their vendor relationships.
segments.tr: 以警察随身摄像头和泰瑟枪设备而闻名的 Axon 公司，已经扩展了其自动车牌识别产品，并开始争取那些正在重新考虑供应商关系的部门。

segments.src: Other, smaller players in the public-safety technology space are making similar pitches, often emphasizing more granular data-retention controls, local (rather than cloud-based) storage options, or stricter limits on cross-agency data sharing as a way to address the concerns driving the backlash.
segments.tr: 公共安全技术领域的其他小型参与者也在进行类似的推销，通常强调更细致的数据保留控制、本地（而非基于云的）存储选项，或对跨机构数据共享的更严格限制，以此作为解决导致抵制问题的方案。

segments.src: Industry analysts note that the fight is unlikely to be resolved quickly.
segments.tr: 行业分析师指出，这场争斗不太可能迅速解决。

segments.src: Automated license-plate readers sit at the intersection of two trends that show no sign of slowing: rising demand from police departments for cost-effective investigative tools, and rising public wariness of always-on data collection in daily life.
segments.tr: 自动车牌识别系统处于两个没有放缓迹象的趋势的交汇点：警察部门对高性价比调查工具的需求不断增长，以及公众对日常生活中无处不在的数据收集的警惕性日益提高。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 未来会怎样

segments.src: Several states are now considering legislation that would set statewide standards for ALPR data retention, require warrants for certain types of queries, or mandate public reporting on how camera networks are used.
segments.tr: 几个州目前正在考虑立法，旨在为 ALPR 数据保留设定全州范围的标准，要求对某些类型的查询提供搜查令，或强制要求公开报告摄像头网络的使用情况。

segments.src: Flock Safety has said it supports "reasonable" regulation and has worked with some state legislatures on model policies.
segments.tr: Flock Safety 表示支持“合理”的监管，并已与一些州立法机构合作制定示范政策。

segments.src: Privacy advocates counter that self-regulation by vendors is insufficient and are pushing for binding state or federal rules.
segments.tr: 隐私倡导者反驳说，供应商的自我监管是不够的，并正在推动具有约束力的州或联邦规则。

segments.src: For now, the debate playing out in city council chambers — and, less constructively, on roadside utility poles — reflects a broader American reckoning with how much automated tracking the public is willing to accept in exchange for the promise of safer streets.
segments.tr: 目前，在市议会会议厅——以及在路边电线杆上（以一种不那么建设性的方式）——上演的辩论，反映了美国社会在为了换取更安全街道的承诺而愿意接受多少自动化追踪方面，正在进行更广泛的权衡。

segments.src: Whether that balance tips toward wider adoption, stricter regulation, or a patchwork of local bans is likely to be decided community by community over the next several years.
segments.tr: 这种平衡是会向更广泛的采用、更严格的监管，还是向一系列地方禁令倾斜，很可能在未来几年内由各个社区自行决定。

segments.src: ## A Quiet Piece of Street Furniture Becomes a Flashpoint
segments.tr: ## सड़क के किनारे का एक शांत उपकरण विवाद का केंद्र बना

segments.src: For years, the solar-powered cameras mounted on poles at neighborhood entrances and highway shoulders drew little attention.
segments.tr: वर्षों से, पड़ोस के प्रवेश द्वारों और राजमार्गों के किनारों पर खंभों पर लगे सौर ऊर्जा से चलने वाले कैमरों पर बहुत कम ध्यान गया।

segments.src: Today, in communities across the country, those same devices have become the target of a sustained wave of public frustration — and, in a number of documented cases, outright vandalism.
segments.tr: आज, देश भर के समुदायों में, वही उपकरण सार्वजनिक निराशा की एक निरंतर लहर का लक्ष्य बन गए हैं - और, कई प्रलेखित मामलों में, सीधे तौर पर तोड़फोड़ का शिकार हुए हैं।

segments.src: The cameras in question are largely made by Flock Safety, a fast-growing company whose automated license-plate readers (ALPRs) have been adopted by thousands of police departments and homeowners' associations.
segments.tr: प्रश्नाधीन कैमरे बड़े पैमाने पर Flock Safety द्वारा बनाए गए हैं, जो एक तेजी से बढ़ती कंपनी है जिसके स्वचालित लाइसेंस-प्लेट रीडर (ALPRs) को हजारों पुलिस विभागों और होमओनर्स एसोसिएशनों द्वारा अपनाया गया है।

segments.src: According to local news reports gathered from multiple states, some units have been found cut from their mounts, defaced with paint, or struck by vehicles.
segments.tr: कई राज्यों से एकत्र की गई स्थानीय समाचार रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, कुछ इकाइयों को उनके माउंट से काटा हुआ, पेंट से बिगाड़ा हुआ या वाहनों से टकराया हुआ पाया गया है।

segments.src: Law enforcement officials in several jurisdictions have opened investigations into these incidents, treating them as property-damage or criminal-mischief cases.
segments.tr: कई न्यायालयों में कानून प्रवर्तन अधिकारियों ने इन घटनाओं की जांच शुरू कर दी है, और इन्हें संपत्ति के नुकसान या आपराधिक शरारत के मामलों के रूप में देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: This article does not endorse or provide guidance on damaging public or private property, which is illegal and can carry serious criminal penalties.
segments.tr: यह लेख सार्वजनिक या निजी संपत्ति को नुकसान पहुंचाने का समर्थन या मार्गदर्शन नहीं करता है, जो कि गैर-कानूनी है और इसमें गंभीर आपराधिक दंड हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: What follows is a look at why a piece of everyday infrastructure has become so contested, and what it says about the broader debate over surveillance technology in American public life.
segments.tr: आगे इस बात पर नज़र डाली गई है कि रोज़मर्रा के बुनियादी ढांचे का एक हिस्सा इतना विवादित क्यों बन गया है, और यह अमेरिकी सार्वजनिक जीवन में निगरानी तकनीक पर व्यापक बहस के बारे में क्या कहता है।

segments.src: ## Why Residents Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## निवासी इसका विरोध क्यों कर रहे हैं

segments.src: Civil liberties organizations, including the Electronic Frontier Foundation and the American Civil Liberties Union, have spent several years warning that networks of ALPR cameras create a de facto tracking system.
segments.tr: Electronic Frontier Foundation और American Civil Liberties Union सहित नागरिक स्वतंत्रता संगठनों ने कई वर्षों तक चेतावनी दी है कि ALPR कैमरों का नेटवर्क वास्तव में एक ट्रैकिंग सिस्टम बनाता है।

segments.src: Individually, each camera simply logs a plate number, timestamp, and location.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत रूप से, प्रत्येक कैमरा केवल एक प्लेट नंबर, टाइमस्टैम्प और स्थान को लॉग करता है।

segments.src: Collectively, advocates argue, a dense network can reconstruct a detailed picture of where a private vehicle — and by extension, its driver — has been over days, weeks, or months, often without a warrant.
segments.tr: सामूहिक रूप से, अधिवक्ताओं का तर्क है कि, एक सघन नेटवर्क यह विस्तृत चित्र फिर से बना सकता है कि एक निजी वाहन - और विस्तार से, उसका ड्राइवर - अक्सर बिना किसी वारंट के दिनों, हफ्तों या महीनों में कहाँ-कहाँ रहा है।

segments.src: That concern has resonated well beyond activist circles.
segments.tr: उस चिंता ने कार्यकर्ताओं के हलकों से परे भी असर डाला है।

segments.src: Homeowners in some subdivisions have objected to being tracked every time they leave their own neighborhood.
segments.tr: कुछ उप-विभागों में रहने वाले गृहस्वामियों ने हर बार अपने पड़ोस से बाहर जाने पर ट्रैक किए जाने पर आपत्ति जताई है।

segments.src: Others have raised questions about who can access the data, how long it is retained, and whether it could be shared with agencies pursuing unrelated investigations, including in states with different laws on reproductive health or immigration enforcement.
segments.tr: दूसरों ने इस बारे में सवाल उठाए हैं कि कौन डेटा तक पहुंच सकता है, इसे कितने समय तक बरकरार रखा जाता है, और क्या इसे असंबद्ध जांच करने वाली एजेंसियों के साथ साझा किया जा सकता है, जिसमें प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य या आव्रजन प्रवर्तन पर अलग-अलग कानूनों वाले राज्य भी शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Flock Safety has said its systems are built with audit trails and access controls, and that the technology has helped police departments solve crimes ranging from car theft to abductions.
segments.tr: Flock Safety ने कहा है कि उसके सिस्टम ऑडिट ट्रेल और एक्सेस कंट्रोल के साथ बनाए गए हैं, और इस तकनीक ने पुलिस विभागों को कार चोरी से लेकर अपहरण तक के अपराधों को सुलझाने में मदद की है।

segments.src: The company has also pointed to internal policies meant to restrict how footage can be queried and shared.
segments.tr: कंपनी ने आंतरिक नीतियां का भी हवाला दिया है जिसका उद्देश्य यह सीमित करना है कि फुटेज को कैसे खोजा और साझा किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Still, the gap between how the technology is marketed — as a tool for solving specific crimes — and how it is actually used in practice has fueled skepticism.
segments.tr: फिर भी, तकनीक को कैसे विपणन किया जाता है - विशिष्ट अपराधों को सुलझाने के लिए एक उपकरण के रूप में - और वास्तव में इसका उपयोग व्यवहार में कैसे किया जाता है, इसके बीच के अंतर ने संदेह को बढ़ावा दिया है।

segments.src: Local reporting has documented cases where camera data was queried far more broadly than departments initially described, prompting renewed scrutiny from city councils and privacy-minded lawmakers.
segments.tr: स्थानीय रिपोर्टिंग ने ऐसे मामलों का दस्तावेजीकरण किया है जहाँ कैमरों के डेटा को विभागों द्वारा शुरू में वर्णित किए जाने की तुलना में बहुत अधिक व्यापक रूप से खोजा गया था, जिससे नगर परिषदों और गोपनीयता-पसंद कानून निर्माताओं से नए सिरे से जांच शुरू हो गई।

segments.src: ## Cities Hit the Brakes
segments.tr: ## शहरों ने लगाई रोक

segments.src: That scrutiny has translated into concrete policy reversals.
segments.tr: उस जांच ने ठोस नीतिगत बदलावों का रूप ले लिया है।

segments.src: Local governments in roughly 100 cities have reportedly voted to deactivate their camera networks, decline to renew existing contracts, or pause new deployments while officials review privacy safeguards, according to tallies compiled by advocacy groups and local news outlets.
segments.tr: एडवोकेसी समूहों और स्थानीय समाचार आउटलेट्स द्वारा संकलित आंकड़ों के अनुसार, लगभग 100 शहरों में स्थानीय सरकारों ने कथित तौर पर अपने कैमरा नेटवर्क को निष्क्रिय करने, मौजूदा अनुबंधों को नवीनीकृत न करने, या नए तैनाती को रोकने के लिए मतदान किया है, जबकि अधिकारी गोपनीयता सुरक्षा उपायों की समीक्षा कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: City council meetings in several states have turned into extended public hearings, with residents on both sides — those who credit the cameras with deterring break-ins and recovering stolen vehicles, and those who see them as an unaccountable surveillance layer — testifying at length.
segments.tr: कई राज्यों में नगर परिषद की बैठकें विस्तारित सार्वजनिक बहसों में बदल गई हैं, जिसमें दोनों पक्षों के निवासियों ने लंबी गवाही दी है — वे जो कैमरों को सेंधमारी को रोकने और चोरी की गाड़ियों की बरामदगी का श्रेय देते हैं, और वे जो उन्हें एक गैर-जवाबदेह निगरानी परत के रूप में देखते हैं।

segments.src: Some departments that paused their programs have cited cost and transparency concerns as much as privacy ones, noting that subscription-based camera networks carry recurring fees that can be difficult to justify to budget-conscious councils without clear, publicly reported outcomes.
segments.tr: कुछ विभागों जिन्होंने अपने कार्यक्रमों को रोक दिया, उन्होंने गोपनीयता के साथ-साथ लागत और पारदर्शिता संबंधी चिंताओं का भी हवाला दिया है, यह देखते हुए कि सदस्यता-आधारित कैमरा नेटवर्क आवर्ती शुल्क लेते हैं जिन्हें स्पष्ट, सार्वजनिक रूप से रिपोर्ट किए गए परिणामों के बिना बजट-सचेत परिषदों को सही ठहराना कठिन हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## A Market Opportunity for Rivals
segments.tr: ## प्रतिस्पर्धियों के लिए एक बाजार अवसर

segments.src: The backlash has not gone unnoticed by Flock Safety's competitors.
segments.tr: इस आक्रोश पर Flock Safety के प्रतिस्पर्धियों का ध्यान नहीं गया है, ऐसा नहीं है।

segments.src: Axon, best known for police body cameras and Taser devices, has expanded its own automated license-plate reading offerings and has begun courting departments that are reconsidering their vendor relationships.
segments.tr: Axon, जो पुलिस बॉडी कैमरों और Taser उपकरणों के लिए सबसे प्रसिद्ध है, ने अपनी स्वचालित लाइसेंस-प्लेट रीडिंग पेशकशों का विस्तार किया है और उन विभागों को आकर्षित करना शुरू कर दिया है जो अपने विक्रेता संबंधों पर पुनर्विचार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Other, smaller players in the public-safety technology space are making similar pitches, often emphasizing more granular data-retention controls, local (rather than cloud-based) storage options, or stricter limits on cross-agency data sharing as a way to address the concerns driving the backlash.
segments.tr: सार्वजनिक-सुरक्षा तकनीक क्षेत्र के अन्य, छोटे खिलाड़ी भी इसी तरह की पेशकश कर रहे हैं, जो अक्सर आक्रोश को जन्म देने वाली चिंताओं को दूर करने के तरीके के रूप में अधिक विस्तृत डेटा-प्रतिधारण नियंत्रण, स्थानीय (क्लाउड-आधारित के बजाय) भंडारण विकल्प, या अंतर-एजेंसी डेटा साझाकरण पर सख्त सीमाओं पर जोर देते हैं।

segments.src: Industry analysts note that the fight is unlikely to be resolved quickly.
segments.tr: उद्योग विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि इस लड़ाई का जल्द समाधान होने की संभावना नहीं है।

segments.src: Automated license-plate readers sit at the intersection of two trends that show no sign of slowing: rising demand from police departments for cost-effective investigative tools, and rising public wariness of always-on data collection in daily life.
segments.tr: स्वचालित लाइसेंस-प्लेट रीडर दो ऐसे रुझानों के चौराहे पर स्थित हैं जो धीमे होने का कोई संकेत नहीं दिखाते हैं: लागत प्रभावी खोजी उपकरणों के लिए पुलिस विभागों से बढ़ती मांग, और दैनिक जीवन में हमेशा ऑन रहने वाले डेटा संग्रह पर जनता की बढ़ती सावधानी।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.tr: कई राज्य अब ऐसे विधान पर विचार कर रहे हैं जो ALPR डेटा प्रतिधारण के लिए राज्यव्यापी मानक निर्धारित करेंगे, कुछ प्रकार की पूछताछ के लिए वारंट की आवश्यकता होगी, या कैमरा नेटवर्क का उपयोग कैसे किया जाता है, इस पर सार्वजनिक रिपोर्टिंग को अनिवार्य करेंगे।

es.title: Sierras, pintura en aerosol y camionetas: el trasfondo de la creciente reacción contra las redes de cámaras de matrículas

segments.src: ## A Quiet Piece of Street Furniture Becomes a Flashpoint
segments.tr: ## Una pieza silenciosa de mobiliario urbano se convierte en un punto crítico

segments.src: For years, the solar-powered cameras mounted on poles at neighborhood entrances and highway shoulders drew little attention.
segments.tr: Durante años, las cámaras alimentadas por energía solar montadas en postes en las entradas de los vecindarios y en los arcenes de las autopistas atrajeron poca atención.

segments.src: Today, in communities across the country, those same devices have become the target of a sustained wave of public frustration — and, in a number of documented cases, outright vandalism.
segments.tr: Hoy en día, en comunidades de todo el país, esos mismos dispositivos se han convertido en el blanco de una ola sostenida de frustración pública y, en varios casos documentados, de vandalismo directo.

segments.src: The cameras in question are largely made by Flock Safety, a fast-growing company whose automated license-plate readers (ALPRs) have been adopted by thousands of police departments and homeowners' associations.
segments.tr: Las cámaras en cuestión son fabricadas en gran parte por Flock Safety, una empresa de rápido crecimiento cuyos lectores automatizados de matrículas (ALPR, por sus siglas en inglés) han sido adoptados por miles de departamentos de policía y asociaciones de propietarios.

segments.src: According to local news reports gathered from multiple states, some units have been found cut from their mounts, defaced with paint, or struck by vehicles.
segments.tr: Según informes de noticias locales recopilados en varios estados, se ha descubierto que algunas unidades han sido cortadas de sus soportes, desfiguradas con pintura o golpeadas por vehículos.

segments.src: Law enforcement officials in several jurisdictions have opened investigations into these incidents, treating them as property-damage or criminal-mischief cases.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios encargados de hacer cumplir la ley en varias jurisdicciones han abierto investigaciones sobre estos incidentes, tratándolos como casos de daños a la propiedad o travesuras criminales.

segments.src: This article does not endorse or provide guidance on damaging public or private property, which is illegal and can carry serious criminal penalties.
segments.tr: Este artículo no respalda ni proporciona orientación sobre cómo dañar la propiedad pública o privada, lo cual es ilegal y puede conllevar graves sanciones penales.

segments.src: What follows is a look at why a piece of everyday infrastructure has become so contested, and what it says about the broader debate over surveillance technology in American public life.
segments.tr: Lo que sigue es una mirada a por qué un elemento de infraestructura cotidiana se ha vuelto tan disputado y qué dice sobre el debate más amplio en torno a la tecnología de vigilancia en la vida pública estadounidense.

segments.src: ## Why Residents Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## Por qué los residentes están contraatacando

segments.src: Civil liberties organizations, including the Electronic Frontier Foundation and the American Civil Liberties Union, have spent several years warning that networks of ALPR cameras create a de facto tracking system.
segments.tr: Las organizaciones de libertades civiles, incluida la Electronic Frontier Foundation y la American Civil Liberties Union, han pasado varios años advirtiendo que las redes de cámaras ALPR crean un sistema de rastreo de facto.

segments.src: Individually, each camera simply logs a plate number, timestamp, and location.
segments.tr: Individualmente, cada cámara simplemente registra un número de matrícula, una marca de tiempo y una ubicación.

segments.src: Collectively, advocates argue, a dense network can reconstruct a detailed picture of where a private vehicle — and by extension, its driver — has been over days, weeks, or months, often without a warrant.
segments.tr: Colectivamente, argumentan los defensores, una red densa puede reconstruir una imagen detallada de dónde ha estado un vehículo privado —y por extensión, su conductor— durante días, semanas o meses, a menudo sin una orden judicial.

segments.src: That concern has resonated well beyond activist circles.
segments.tr: Esa preocupación ha resonado mucho más allá de los círculos activistas.

segments.src: Homeowners in some subdivisions have objected to being tracked every time they leave their own neighborhood.
segments.tr: Los propietarios de viviendas en algunas subdivisiones se han opuesto a ser rastreados cada vez que salen de su propio vecindario.

segments.src: Others have raised questions about who can access the data, how long it is retained, and whether it could be shared with agencies pursuing unrelated investigations, including in states with different laws on reproductive health or immigration enforcement.
segments.tr: Otros han planteado preguntas sobre quién puede acceder a los datos, cuánto tiempo se retienen y si podrían compartirse con agencias que persiguen investigaciones no relacionadas, incluso en estados con diferentes leyes sobre salud reproductiva o control de inmigración.

segments.src: Flock Safety has said its systems are built with audit trails and access controls, and that the technology has helped police departments solve crimes ranging from car theft to abductions.
segments.tr: Flock Safety ha dicho que sus sistemas están construidos con pistas de auditoría y controles de acceso, y que la tecnología ha ayudado a los departamentos de policía a resolver delitos que van desde el robo de automóviles hasta secuestros.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to internal policies meant to restrict how footage can be queried and shared.
segments.tr: La empresa también ha señalado políticas internas destinadas a restringir cómo se pueden consultar y compartir las grabaciones.

segments.src: Still, the gap between how the technology is marketed — as a tool for solving specific crimes — and how it is actually used in practice has fueled skepticism.
segments.tr: Aún así, la brecha entre cómo se comercializa la tecnología —como una herramienta para resolver delitos específicos— y cómo se utiliza realmente en la práctica ha alimentado el escepticismo.

segments.src: Local reporting has documented cases where camera data was queried far more broadly than departments initially described, prompting renewed scrutiny from city councils and privacy-minded lawmakers.
segments.tr: Los reportajes locales han documentado casos en los que los datos de las cámaras se consultaron de manera mucho más amplia de lo que los departamentos describieron inicialmente, lo que provocó un nuevo escrutinio por parte de los ayuntamientos y legisladores preocupados por la privacidad.

segments.src: ## Cities Hit the Brakes
segments.tr: ## Las ciudades pisan el freno

segments.src: That scrutiny has translated into concrete policy reversals.
segments.tr: Ese escrutinio se ha traducido en reversiones de políticas concretas.

segments.src: Local governments in roughly 100 cities have reportedly voted to deactivate their camera networks, decline to renew existing contracts, or pause new deployments while officials review privacy safeguards, according to tallies compiled by advocacy groups and local news outlets.
segments.tr: Los gobiernos locales en aproximadamente 100 ciudades supuestamente han votado para desactivar sus redes de cámaras, negarse a renovar los contratos existentes o pausar nuevas implementaciones mientras los funcionarios revisan las salvaguardas de privacidad, según los recuentos compilados por grupos de defensa y medios de noticias locales.

segments.src: City council meetings in several states have turned into extended public hearings, with residents on both sides — those who credit the cameras with deterring break-ins and recovering stolen vehicles, and those who see them as an unaccountable surveillance layer — testifying at length.
segments.tr: Las reuniones de los ayuntamientos en varios estados se han convertido en audiencias públicas prolongadas, con residentes de ambos bandos —aquellos que acreditan a las cámaras la disuasión de robos con fuerza y la recuperación de vehículos robados, y aquellos que las ven como una capa de vigilancia inescrutable— testificando extensamente.

segments.src: Some departments that paused their programs have cited cost and transparency concerns as much as privacy ones, noting that subscription-based camera networks carry recurring fees that can be difficult to justify to budget-conscious councils without clear, publicly reported outcomes.
segments.tr: Algunos departamentos que pausaron sus programas han citado preocupaciones de costo y transparencia tanto como las de privacidad, señalando que las redes de cámaras basadas en suscripción conllevan tarifas recurrentes que pueden ser difíciles de justificar ante consejos conscientes del presupuesto sin resultados claros y reportados públicamente.

segments.src: ## A Market Opportunity for Rivals
segments.tr: ## Una oportunidad de mercado para los rivales

segments.src: The backlash has not gone unnoticed by Flock Safety's competitors.
segments.tr: La reacción violenta no ha pasado desapercibida para los competidores de Flock Safety.

segments.src: Axon, best known for police body cameras and Taser devices, has expanded its own automated license-plate reading offerings and has begun courting departments that are reconsidering their vendor relationships.
segments.tr: Axon, mejor conocida por las cámaras corporales de la policía y los dispositivos Taser, ha ampliado sus propias ofertas de lectura automatizada de matrículas y ha comenzado a cortejar a los departamentos que están reconsiderando sus relaciones con los proveedores.

segments.src: Other, smaller players in the public-safety technology space are making similar pitches, often emphasizing more granular data-retention controls, local (rather than cloud-based) storage options, or stricter limits on cross-agency data sharing as a way to address the concerns driving the backlash.
segments.tr: Otros actores más pequeños en el espacio de la tecnología de seguridad pública están haciendo propuestas similares, a menudo enfatizando controles de retención de datos más granulares, opciones de almacenamiento local (en lugar de basadas en la nube) o límites más estrictos en el intercambio de datos entre agencias como una forma de abordar las preocupaciones que impulsan la reacción violenta.

segments.src: Industry analysts note that the fight is unlikely to be resolved quickly.
segments.tr: Los analistas de la industria señalan que es poco probable que la pelea se resuelva rápidamente.

segments.src: Automated license-plate readers sit at the intersection of two trends that show no sign of slowing: rising demand from police departments for cost-effective investigative tools, and rising public wariness of always-on data collection in daily life.
segments.tr: Los lectores automatizados de matrículas se encuentran en la intersección de dos tendencias que no muestran signos de desaceleración: la creciente demanda de los departamentos de policía de herramientas de investigación rentables y la creciente desconfianza pública hacia la recopilación de datos siempre activa en la vida diaria.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Lo que viene a continuación

segments.src: Several states are now considering legislation that would set statewide standards for ALPR data retention, require warrants for certain types of queries, or mandate public reporting on how camera networks are used.
segments.tr: Varios estados están considerando ahora una legislación que establecería estándares estatales para la retención de datos de ALPR, exigiría órdenes judiciales para ciertos tipos de consultas o mandataría informes públicos sobre cómo se utilizan las redes de cámaras.

segments.src: Flock Safety has said it supports "reasonable" regulation and has worked with some state legislatures on model policies.
segments.tr: Flock Safety ha dicho que apoya una regulación "razonable" y ha trabajado con algunas legislaturas estatales en políticas modelo.

segments.src: Privacy advocates counter that self-regulation by vendors is insufficient and are pushing for binding state or federal rules.
segments.tr: Los defensores de la privacidad replican que la autorregulación por parte de los proveedores es insuficiente y están presionando para que se establezcan normas estatales o federales vinculantes.

segments.src: For now, the debate playing out in city council chambers — and, less constructively, on roadside utility poles — reflects a broader American reckoning with how much automated tracking the public is willing to accept in exchange for the promise of safer streets.
segments.tr: Por ahora, el debate que se desarrolla en las cámaras de los ayuntamientos —y, de manera menos constructiva, en los postes de servicios públicos de las carreteras— refleja un reconocimiento estadounidense más amplio sobre cuánta vigilancia automatizada el público está dispuesto a aceptar a cambio de la promesa de calles más seguras.

segments.src: Whether that balance tips toward wider adoption, stricter regulation, or a patchwork of local bans is likely to be decided community by community over the next several years.
segments.tr: Es probable que ese equilibrio se incline hacia una adopción más amplia, una regulación más estricta o un mosaico de prohibiciones locales se decida comunidad por comunidad durante los próximos años.

fr.title: Scies, peinture en aérosol et camionnettes : Dans les coulisses de la contestation croissante contre les réseaux de caméras de lecture de plaques d'immatriculation

segments.src: ## A Quiet Piece of Street Furniture Becomes a Flashpoint
segments.tr: ## Un simple mobilier urbain devient un point chaud

segments.src: For years, the solar-powered cameras mounted on poles at neighborhood entrances and highway shoulders drew little attention.
segments.tr: Pendant des années, les caméras solaires montées sur des poteaux à l'entrée des quartiers et sur les accotements des autoroutes ont suscité peu d'attention.

segments.src: Today, in communities across the country, those same devices have become the target of a sustained wave of public frustration — and, in a number of documented cases, outright vandalism.
segments.tr: Aujourd'hui, dans des communautés à travers le pays, ces mêmes appareils sont devenus la cible d'une vague persistante de frustration publique — et, dans un certain nombre de cas documentés, de vandalisme pur et simple.

segments.src: The cameras in question are largely made by Flock Safety, a fast-growing company whose automated license-plate readers (ALPRs) have been adopted by thousands of police departments and homeowners' associations.
segments.tr: Les caméras en question sont principalement fabriquées par Flock Safety, une entreprise en forte croissance dont les lecteurs automatiques de plaques d'immatriculation (LAPI) ont été adoptés par des milliers de services de police et d'associations de propriétaires.

segments.src: According to local news reports gathered from multiple states, some units have been found cut from their mounts, defaced with paint, or struck by vehicles.
segments.tr: Selon des reportages locaux recueillis dans plusieurs États, certaines unités ont été trouvées coupées de leurs supports, vandalisées avec de la peinture ou heurtées par des véhicules.

segments.src: Law enforcement officials in several jurisdictions have opened investigations into these incidents, treating them as property-damage or criminal-mischief cases.
segments.tr: Les forces de l'ordre de plusieurs juridictions ont ouvert des enquêtes sur ces incidents, les traitant comme des affaires de dommages matériels ou de méfait criminel.

segments.src: This article does not endorse or provide guidance on damaging public or private property, which is illegal and can carry serious criminal penalties.
segments.tr: Cet article n'encourage pas et ne fournit pas de conseils sur la dégradation de biens publics ou privés, ce qui est illégal et peut entraîner de graves sanctions pénales.

segments.src: What follows is a look at why a piece of everyday infrastructure has become so contested, and what it says about the broader debate over surveillance technology in American public life.
segments.tr: Ce qui suit est un aperçu de la raison pour laquelle un élément d'infrastructure du quotidien est devenu si contesté, et de ce que cela révèle sur le débat plus large concernant la technologie de surveillance dans la vie publique américaine.

segments.src: ## Why Residents Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les résidents se mobilisent

segments.src: Civil liberties organizations, including the Electronic Frontier Foundation and the American Civil Liberties Union, have spent several years warning that networks of ALPR cameras create a de facto tracking system.
segments.tr: Des organisations de défense des libertés civiles, notamment l'Electronic Frontier Foundation et l'American Civil Liberties Union, ont passé plusieurs années à avertir que les réseaux de caméras LAPI créent un système de suivi de facto.

segments.src: Individually, each camera simply logs a plate number, timestamp, and location.
segments.tr: Individuellement, chaque caméra enregistre simplement un numéro de plaque, un horodatage et un emplacement.

segments.src: Collectively, advocates argue, a dense network can reconstruct a detailed picture of where a private vehicle — and by extension, its driver — has been over days, weeks, or months, often without a warrant.
segments.tr: Collectivement, affirment les défenseurs, un réseau dense peut reconstituer une image détaillée de l'endroit où un véhicule privé — et par extension, son conducteur — s'est trouvé au fil des jours, des semaines ou des mois, souvent sans mandat.

segments.src: That concern has resonated well beyond activist circles.
segments.tr: Cette préoccupation a résonné bien au-delà des cercles militants.

segments.src: Homeowners in some subdivisions have objected to being tracked every time they leave their own neighborhood.
segments.tr: Des propriétaires de certains lotissements se sont opposés à l'idée d'être suivis chaque fois qu'ils quittent leur propre quartier.

segments.src: Others have raised questions about who can access the data, how long it is retained, and whether it could be shared with agencies pursuing unrelated investigations, including in states with different laws on reproductive health or immigration enforcement.
segments.tr: D'autres ont soulevé des questions sur qui peut accéder aux données, combien de temps elles sont conservées et si elles pourraient être partagées avec des agences menant des enquêtes sans rapport, notamment dans des États ayant des lois différentes sur la santé reproductive ou le contrôle de l'immigration.

segments.src: Flock Safety has said its systems are built with audit trails and access controls, and that the technology has helped police departments solve crimes ranging from car theft to abductions.
segments.tr: Flock Safety a déclaré que ses systèmes sont conçus avec des pistes d'audit et des contrôles d'accès, et que la technologie a aidé les services de police à résoudre des crimes allant du vol de voiture aux enlèvements.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to internal policies meant to restrict how footage can be queried and shared.
segments.tr: L'entreprise a également souligné des politiques internes destinées à restreindre la manière dont les images peuvent être interrogées et partagées.

segments.src: Still, the gap between how the technology is marketed — as a tool for solving specific crimes — and how it is actually used in practice has fueled skepticism.
segments.tr: Pourtant, le fossé entre la façon dont la technologie est commercialisée — comme un outil pour résoudre des crimes spécifiques — et la façon dont elle est réellement utilisée en pratique a alimenté le scepticisme.

segments.src: Local reporting has documented cases where camera data was queried far more broadly than departments initially described, prompting renewed scrutiny from city councils and privacy-minded lawmakers.
segments.tr: Des reportages locaux ont documenté des cas où les données des caméras ont été interrogées de manière beaucoup plus large que ne l'avaient initialement décrit les services, suscitant un nouvel examen de la part des conseils municipaux et des législateurs soucieux de la vie privée.

segments.src: ## Cities Hit the Brakes
segments.tr: ## Les villes freinent des quatre fers

segments.src: That scrutiny has translated into concrete policy reversals.
segments.tr: Cet examen minutieux s'est traduit par des changements de politique concrets.

segments.src: Local governments in roughly 100 cities have reportedly voted to deactivate their camera networks, decline to renew existing contracts, or pause new deployments while officials review privacy safeguards, according to tallies compiled by advocacy groups and local news outlets.
segments.tr: Les gouvernements locaux d'environ 100 villes auraient voté pour désactiver leurs réseaux de caméras, refuser de renouveler les contrats existants ou suspendre de nouveaux déploiements pendant que les responsables examinent les mesures de protection de la vie privée, selon des décomptes compilés par des groupes de défense et des médias locaux.

segments.src: City council meetings in several states have turned into extended public hearings, with residents on both sides — those who credit the cameras with deterring break-ins and recovering stolen vehicles, and those who see them as an unaccountable surveillance layer — testifying at length.
segments.tr: Les réunions des conseils municipaux dans plusieurs États se sont transformées en longues audiences publiques, avec des résidents des deux côtés — ceux qui attribuent aux caméras la dissuasion des effractions et la récupération de véhicules volés, et ceux qui les voient comme une couche de surveillance irresponsable — témoignant longuement.

segments.src: Some departments that paused their programs have cited cost and transparency concerns as much as privacy ones, noting that subscription-based camera networks carry recurring fees that can be difficult to justify to budget-conscious councils without clear, publicly reported outcomes.
segments.tr: Certains services ayant suspendu leurs programmes ont invoqué des préoccupations de coût et de transparence autant que de vie privée, notant que les réseaux de caméras par abonnement entraînent des frais récurrents qui peuvent être difficiles à justifier auprès de conseils soucieux de leur budget sans résultats clairs et signalés publiquement.

segments.src: ## A Market Opportunity for Rivals
segments.tr: ## Une opportunité de marché pour les rivaux

segments.src: The backlash has not gone unnoticed by Flock Safety's competitors.
segments.tr: La réaction négative n'est pas passée inaperçue auprès des concurrents de Flock Safety.

segments.src: Axon, best known for police body cameras and Taser devices, has expanded its own automated license-plate reading offerings and has begun courting departments that are reconsidering their vendor relationships.
segments.tr: Axon, mieux connu pour ses caméras piétons de police et ses pistolets Taser, a élargi ses propres offres de lecture automatique de plaques d'immatriculation et a commencé à courtiser les services qui réévaluent leurs relations avec leurs fournisseurs.

segments.src: Other, smaller players in the public-safety technology space are making similar pitches, often emphasizing more granular data-retention controls, local (rather than cloud-based) storage options, or stricter limits on cross-agency data sharing as a way to address the concerns driving the backlash.
segments.tr: D'autres acteurs plus petits dans le domaine de la technologie de la sécurité publique font des propositions similaires, mettant souvent l'accent sur des contrôles de conservation des données plus précis, des options de stockage local (plutôt que dans le cloud) ou des limites plus strictes sur le partage de données entre agences comme moyen de répondre aux préoccupations qui motivent la contestation.

segments.src: Industry analysts note that the fight is unlikely to be resolved quickly.
segments.tr: Les analystes du secteur notent que le combat ne sera probablement pas résolu rapidement.

segments.src: Automated license-plate readers sit at the intersection of two trends that show no sign of slowing: rising demand from police departments for cost-effective investigative tools, and rising public wariness of always-on data collection in daily life.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs automatiques de plaques d'immatriculation se trouvent à l'intersection de deux tendances qui ne montrent aucun signe de ralentissement : la demande croissante des services de police pour des outils d'enquête rentables et la méfiance publique croissante à l'égard de la collecte de données permanente dans la vie quotidienne.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite

segments.src: Several states are now considering legislation that would set statewide standards for ALPR data retention, require warrants for certain types of queries, or mandate public reporting on how camera networks are used.
segments.tr: Plusieurs États envisagent actuellement une législation qui établirait des normes à l'échelle de l'État pour la conservation des données LAPI, exigerait des mandats pour certains types de requêtes ou imposerait des rapports publics sur la manière dont les réseaux de caméras sont utilisés.

segments.src: Flock Safety has said it supports "reasonable" regulation and has worked with some state legislatures on model policies.
segments.tr: Flock Safety a déclaré qu'elle soutenait une réglementation « raisonnable » et qu'elle avait collaboré avec certains législatures d'État sur des politiques modèles.

segments.src: Privacy advocates counter that self-regulation by vendors is insufficient and are pushing for binding state or federal rules.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs de la vie privée répliquent que l'autorégulation par les fournisseurs est insuffisante et poussent pour des règles contraignantes au niveau des États ou fédéral.

segments.src: For now, the debate playing out in city council chambers — and, less constructively, on roadside utility poles — reflects a broader American reckoning with how much automated tracking the public is willing to accept in exchange for the promise of safer streets.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, le débat qui se déroule dans les salles des conseils municipaux — et, de manière moins constructive, sur les poteaux électriques au bord des routes — reflète une prise de conscience plus large aux États-Unis sur la quantité de suivi automatisé que le public est prêt à accepter en échange de la promesse de rues plus sûres.

segments.src: Whether that balance tips toward wider adoption, stricter regulation, or a patchwork of local bans is likely to be decided community by community over the next several years.
segments.tr: Que cet équilibre penche vers une adoption plus large, une réglementation plus stricte ou un ensemble de interdictions locales sera probablement décidé communauté par communauté au cours des prochaines années.

in.title: Gergaji, Cat Semprot, dan Truk Pikap: Di Balik Meningkatnya Penolakan Terhadap Jaringan Kamera Pelat Nomor

segments.src: ## A Quiet Piece of Street Furniture Becomes a Flashpoint
segments.tr: ## Perabotan Jalan yang Tenang Menjadi Titik Panas

segments.src: For years, the solar-powered cameras mounted on poles at neighborhood entrances and highway shoulders drew little attention.
segments.tr: Selama bertahun-tahun, kamera bertenaga surya yang dipasang di tiang-tiang di pintu masuk lingkungan dan bahu jalan tol hampir tidak menarik perhatian.

segments.src: Today, in communities across the country, those same devices have become the target of a sustained wave of public frustration — and, in a number of documented cases, outright vandalism.
segments.tr: Saat ini, di berbagai komunitas di seluruh negeri, perangkat yang sama telah menjadi target gelombang frustrasi publik yang berkelanjutan — dan, dalam sejumlah kasus yang didokumentasikan, vandalisme terang-terangan.

segments.src: The cameras in question are largely made by Flock Safety, a fast-growing company whose automated license-plate readers (ALPRs) have been adopted by thousands of police departments and homeowners' associations.
segments.tr: Kamera yang dimaksud sebagian besar dibuat oleh Flock Safety, sebuah perusahaan yang berkembang pesat yang pembaca pelat nomor otomatisnya (ALPR) telah diadopsi oleh ribuan departemen kepolisian dan asosiasi pemilik rumah.

segments.src: According to local news reports gathered from multiple states, some units have been found cut from their mounts, defaced with paint, or struck by vehicles.
segments.tr: Menurut laporan berita lokal yang dikumpulkan dari berbagai negara bagian, beberapa unit ditemukan dipotong dari tempatnya, dirusak dengan cat, atau ditabrak kendaraan.

segments.src: Law enforcement officials in several jurisdictions have opened investigations into these incidents, treating them as property-damage or criminal-mischief cases.
segments.tr: Pejabat penegak hukum di beberapa yurisdiksi telah membuka penyelidikan atas insiden ini, memperlakukannya sebagai kasus perusakan properti atau kejahatan.

segments.src: This article does not endorse or provide guidance on damaging public or private property, which is illegal and can carry serious criminal penalties.
segments.tr: Artikel ini tidak mendukung atau memberikan panduan tentang merusak properti publik atau pribadi, yang merupakan tindakan ilegal dan dapat membawa sanksi pidana yang berat.

segments.src: What follows is a look at why a piece of everyday infrastructure has become so contested, and what it says about the broader debate over surveillance technology in American public life.
segments.tr: Berikut ini adalah tinjauan mengenai mengapa infrastruktur sehari-hari menjadi begitu diperdebatkan, dan apa artinya bagi perdebatan yang lebih luas tentang teknologi pengawasan dalam kehidupan publik Amerika.

segments.src: ## Why Residents Are Pushing Back
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Warga Melakukan Perlawanan

segments.src: Civil liberties organizations, including the Electronic Frontier Foundation and the American Civil Liberties Union, have spent several years warning that networks of ALPR cameras create a de facto tracking system.
segments.tr: Organisasi kebebasan sipil, termasuk Electronic Frontier Foundation dan American Civil Liberties Union, telah menghabiskan waktu beberapa tahun untuk memperingatkan bahwa jaringan kamera ALPR menciptakan sistem pelacakan de facto.

segments.src: Individually, each camera simply logs a plate number, timestamp, and location.
segments.tr: Secara individual, setiap kamera hanya mencatat nomor pelat, stempel waktu, dan lokasi.

segments.src: Collectively, advocates argue, a dense network can reconstruct a detailed picture of where a private vehicle — and by extension, its driver — has been over days, weeks, or months, often without a warrant.
segments.tr: Secara kolektif, para advokat berpendapat, jaringan yang padat dapat merekonstruksi gambaran rinci tentang di mana kendaraan pribadi — dan oleh karena itu, pengemudinya — telah berada selama berhari-hari, berminggu-minggu, atau berbulan-bulan, seringkali tanpa surat perintah.

segments.src: That concern has resonated well beyond activist circles.
segments.tr: Kekhawatiran itu telah beresonansi jauh di luar lingkaran aktivis.

segments.src: Homeowners in some subdivisions have objected to being tracked every time they leave their own neighborhood.
segments.tr: Para pemilik rumah di beberapa subdivisi keberatan dilacak setiap kali mereka meninggalkan lingkungan mereka sendiri.

segments.src: Others have raised questions about who can access the data, how long it is retained, and whether it could be shared with agencies pursuing unrelated investigations, including in states with different laws on reproductive health or immigration enforcement.
segments.tr: Yang lain mengajukan pertanyaan tentang siapa yang dapat mengakses data tersebut, berapa lama data tersebut disimpan, dan apakah data tersebut dapat dibagikan dengan lembaga yang menyelidiki kasus yang tidak terkait, termasuk di negara bagian dengan undang-undang kesehatan reproduksi atau penegakan imigrasi yang berbeda.

segments.src: Flock Safety has said its systems are built with audit trails and access controls, and that the technology has helped police departments solve crimes ranging from car theft to abductions.
segments.tr: Flock Safety telah menyatakan bahwa sistemnya dibangun dengan jejak audit dan kontrol akses, dan bahwa teknologi tersebut telah membantu departemen kepolisian memecahkan kejahatan mulai dari pencurian mobil hingga penculikan.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to internal policies meant to restrict how footage can be queried and shared.
segments.tr: Perusahaan juga telah menunjuk pada kebijakan internal yang dimaksudkan untuk membatasi bagaimana rekaman dapat kueri dan dibagikan.

segments.src: Still, the gap between how the technology is marketed — as a tool for solving specific crimes — and how it is actually used in practice has fueled skepticism.
segments.tr: Namun, kesenjangan antara bagaimana teknologi dipasarkan — sebagai alat untuk menyelesaikan kejahatan tertentu — dan bagaimana teknologi tersebut benar-benar digunakan dalam praktiknya telah memicu skeptisisme.

segments.src: Local reporting has documented cases where camera data was queried far more broadly than departments initially described, prompting renewed scrutiny from city councils and privacy-minded lawmakers.
segments.tr: Pelaporan lokal telah mendokumentasikan kasus-kasus di mana data kamera dikueri jauh lebih luas daripada yang dijelaskan oleh departemen pada awalnya, memicu pengawasan baru dari dewan kota dan anggota parlemen yang peduli privasi.

segments.src: ## Cities Hit the Brakes
segments.tr: ## Kota-Kota Menginjak Rem

segments.src: That scrutiny has translated into concrete policy reversals.
segments.tr: Pengawasan tersebut telah diterjemahkan menjadi pembalikan kebijakan yang konkret.

segments.src: Local governments in roughly 100 cities have reportedly voted to deactivate their camera networks, decline to renew existing contracts, or pause new deployments while officials review privacy safeguards, according to tallies compiled by advocacy groups and local news outlets.
segments.tr: Pemerintah daerah di sekitar 100 kota dilaporkan telah memilih untuk menonaktifkan jaringan kamera mereka, menolak untuk memperbarui kontrak yang ada, atau menghentikan sementara penerapan baru sementara para pejabat meninjau pengamanan privasi, menurut penghitungan yang dikumpulkan oleh kelompok advokasi dan outlet berita lokal.

segments.src: City council meetings in several states have turned into extended public hearings, with residents on both sides — those who credit the cameras with deterring break-ins and recovering stolen vehicles, and those who see them as an unaccountable surveillance layer — testifying at length.
segments.tr: Rapat dewan kota di beberapa negara bagian telah berubah menjadi dengar pendapat publik yang panjang, dengan warga di kedua sisi — mereka yang memuji kamera karena mencegah pembobolan dan memulihkan kendaraan curian, dan mereka yang melihatnya sebagai lapisan pengawasan yang tidak dapat dipertanggungjawabkan — memberikan kesaksian secara rinci.

segments.src: Some departments that paused their programs have cited cost and transparency concerns as much as privacy ones, noting that subscription-based camera networks carry recurring fees that can be difficult to justify to budget-conscious councils without clear, publicly reported outcomes.
segments.tr: Beberapa departemen yang menghentikan program mereka telah mengutip masalah biaya dan transparansi sebanyak masalah privasi, mencatat bahwa jaringan kamera berbasis langganan membawa biaya berulang yang sulit dibenarkan kepada dewan yang sadar anggaran tanpa hasil yang jelas dan dilaporkan secara publik.

segments.src: ## A Market Opportunity for Rivals
segments.tr: ## Peluang Pasar bagi Pesaing

segments.src: The backlash has not gone unnoticed by Flock Safety's competitors.
segments.tr: Reaksi keras tersebut tidak luput dari perhatian para pesaing Flock Safety.

segments.src: Axon, best known for police body cameras and Taser devices, has expanded its own automated license-plate reading offerings and has begun courting departments that are reconsidering their vendor relationships.
segments.tr: Axon, yang terkenal dengan kamera badan polisi dan perangkat Taser, telah memperluas penawaran pembaca pelat nomor otomatisnya sendiri dan mulai mendekati departemen yang sedang mempertimbangkan kembali hubungan vendor mereka.

segments.src: Other, smaller players in the public-safety technology space are making similar pitches, often emphasizing more granular data-retention controls, local (rather than cloud-based) storage options, or stricter limits on cross-agency data sharing as a way to address the concerns driving the backlash.
segments.tr: Pemain lain yang lebih kecil di ruang teknologi keselamatan publik membuat penawaran serupa, sering kali menekankan kontrol retensi data yang lebih terperinci, opsi penyimpanan lokal (bukan berbasis cloud), atau batas yang lebih ketat pada berbagi data antar-agensi sebagai cara untuk mengatasi kekhawatiran yang memicu reaksi keras.

segments.src: Industry analysts note that the fight is unlikely to be resolved quickly.
segments.tr: Analis industri mencatat bahwa pertarungan tersebut tidak mungkin diselesaikan dengan cepat.

segments.src: Automated license-plate readers sit at the intersection of two trends that show no sign of slowing: rising demand from police departments for cost-effective investigative tools, and rising public wariness of always-on data collection in daily life.
segments.tr: Pembaca pelat nomor otomatis berada di persimpangan dua tren yang tidak menunjukkan tanda-tanda melambat: meningkatnya permintaan dari departemen kepolisian untuk alat investigasi yang hemat biaya, dan meningkatnya kewaspadaan publik terhadap pengumpulan data yang selalu aktif dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: Several states are now considering legislation that would set statewide standards for ALPR data retention, require warrants for certain types of queries, or mandate public reporting on how camera networks are used.
segments.tr: Beberapa negara bagian sekarang sedang mempertimbangkan undang-undang yang akan menetapkan standar seluruh negara bagian untuk retensi data ALPR, memerlukan surat perintah untuk jenis kueri tertentu, atau mewajibkan pelaporan publik tentang bagaimana jaringan kamera digunakan.

segments.src: Flock Safety has said it supports "reasonable" regulation and has worked with some state legislatures on model policies.
segments.tr: Flock Safety telah menyatakan bahwa mereka mendukung regulasi yang "wajar" dan telah bekerja sama dengan beberapa badan legislatif negara bagian pada kebijakan model.

segments.src: Privacy advocates counter that self-regulation by vendors is insufficient and are pushing for binding state or federal rules.
segments.tr: Para pendukung privasi membalas bahwa regulasi mandiri oleh vendor tidak mencukupi dan mendorong aturan negara bagian atau federal yang mengikat.

segments.src: For now, the debate playing out in city council chambers — and, less constructively, on roadside utility poles — reflects a broader American reckoning with how much automated tracking the public is willing to accept in exchange for the promise of safer streets.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, perdebatan yang terjadi di ruang dewan kota — dan, dengan cara yang kurang konstruktif, di tiang utilitas pinggir jalan — mencerminkan perhitungan Amerika yang lebih luas tentang seberapa banyak pelacakan otomatis yang bersedia diterima oleh publik sebagai imbalan atas janji jalanan yang lebih aman.

segments.src: Whether that balance tips toward wider adoption, stricter regulation, or a patchwork of local bans is likely to be decided community by community over the next several years.
segments.tr: Apakah keseimbangan itu condong ke arah adopsi yang lebih luas, regulasi yang lebih ketat, atau tambal sulam larangan lokal kemungkinan akan ditentukan dari komunitas ke komunitas selama beberapa tahun ke depan.
